scope: Independent audit from durable claim/run/return evidence only. No shared authority, queue, epoch, convergence, architecture or product state was mutated.

independent_evidence_matrix.finding: Seven Wave-1 opportunity return directories exist and each reconstructed Wave-1 opportunity has a readable durable RETURN. Later queue activity is excluded from this historical wave boundary.

Exactly one current claim path exists for each of the seven Wave-1 opportunities and each inspected run references its own claim. This proves current-path uniqueness, not by itself the full history of failed competing attempts.
All seven inspected Wave-1 run artifacts are terminal DONE and reference their corresponding durable RETURN path; run/return worker identities match within each individual opportunity.

All seven runs contain started_at before return/completion, but only WBOOT explicitly records STARTED-before-substantive-work. For the other six, final run JSON does not independently prove that the STARTED bytes were durable before the first substantive read/effect. Parent snapshot's PARTIAL_PASS is supported.

WBOOT RETURN durably records two lost create-only races (BIG09 and ROOT-ALUMNOS), reload/no-overwrite behavior, and later successful WBOOT claim. Winning claim files predate WBOOT's successful claim, so the narrative is plausible and internally consistent. However no append-only loser-attempt/host receipt independently proves the rejected create operations. Parent PASS_CANARY is stronger than the available independent evidence.

No second run was observed for any Wave-1 opportunity and no duplicate claim path exists. The canary demonstrates no observed duplicate execution, but does not yet provide an immutable claim-attempt ledger sufficient to reconstruct all contenders.

WBOOT -> PROPOSALS is fully lineaged: identical worker_instance_id, later fresh claim/run, explicit SECOND_AND_FINAL_CANARY_OPPORTUNITY, and final no-third-claim state. BIG13 -> POSTRETURN is asserted in POSTRETURN post_return_evidence, but worker_instance_id changes from WC-GPT56SOL-20260916-2200-BIG13 to WC-GPT56SOL-20260916-2203-POSTRETURN and no previous_run_ref/session_id links the two. Therefore only one of the two claimed second-claim chains is independently proven from durable identity fields.

BIG09 and ROOT-ALUMNOS explicitly record queue/claim rescans; PROPOSALS explicitly records a final queue+claims scan; POSTRETURN records budget exhaustion. Equivalent post-return receipts are not uniform across all seven first runs.

Every inspected claim/run declares claim + own run + own return scope, and returns state no shared authority mutation. This audit did not find contradictory durable evidence, but the artifacts do not contain per-run commit/write-set receipts sufficient to independently prove that no out-of-scope repository path was touched. Parent PASS_CANARY should be interpreted as contract/observational evidence, not a commit-level proof.
Wave-1 runs use heterogeneous manually declared read scopes/epoch fields rather than uniform generated L0/L1/L2 Context Receipts. Parent snapshot is accurate here.

Wave-1 itself did not complete a dedicated independent critic. This O-VERIFY-SWARM-WAVE1-V1 run is a fresh worker that challenged the parent snapshot and found two overclaims, so the independent-verifier handoff path is now exercised; automated critic cadence remains unproven.

The seven RETURNS contain substantive candidate outputs rather than completion placeholders: BIG09 Steward/Merger and integration-ledger semantics; BIG13 learning/Goldens/Vaccines/falsification contracts; Facultad and Alumnos root/discovery maps; WBOOT bootstrap/race contract; POSTRETURN decision matrix; PROPOSALS append-only proposal contract. Utility is evidenced at candidate level; parent/steward consumption/promotion is a separate authority question.
No generic stale reclaim/supersession mechanism is exercised by Wave-1.
Wave-1 opportunities were parent-seeded. Later planner activity is outside this audit boundary and cannot retroactively prove Wave-1 recursive generation.

falsifiable_remediation_candidates.mission: Persist immutable claim-attempt receipts for both winners and losers, including opportunity_id, worker/session id, attempted_at, host result class, exact existence recheck result, winning claim ref when present, and no-overwrite decision.
falsifiable_remediation_candidates.falsifier: Two workers deliberately race one opportunity; an independent verifier reconstructs winner and loser ordering using only durable receipts and verifies no loser update occurred.

falsifiable_remediation_candidates.mission: Separate stable session_id from worker_instance_id and require previous_run_ref + continuation_index on every post-return second claim/run.
falsifiable_remediation_candidates.falsifier: A two-job session is rejected as unproven if previous_run_ref is absent/unresolvable, continuation_index is not monotonic, or session_id changes without an explicit handoff artifact.

falsifiable_remediation_candidates.mission: Record STARTED persistence commit/receipt before substantive work and carry that immutable receipt into RETURN/DONE evidence.
falsifiable_remediation_candidates.falsifier: Deliberately attempt substantive execution without a resolvable STARTED receipt; worker must fail closed and produce no mission result.

falsifiable_remediation_candidates.mission: Attach commit SHA(s) and changed-path set to each run so an independent verifier can compare actual writes against declared write_scope.
falsifiable_remediation_candidates.falsifier: Inject an out-of-scope path change in a test run; verifier must flag scope violation even if run/return prose claims isolation.

falsifiable_remediation_candidates.mission: Record parent/steward disposition for each candidate RETURN so useful-output production is distinguished from accepted/consumed/rejected/deferred integration value.
falsifiable_remediation_candidates.falsifier: A substantive-looking RETURN with no consumption/disposition cannot be counted as integrated value merely because it is long or terminal DONE.

negative_knowledge: One claim file per opportunity proves current exclusivity shape, not the complete history of collision attempts.
A worker's own statement that it lost a race is durable documentation but not independent host evidence.
A post-return note saying a prior task was completed does not establish same-session lineage when stable session/previous-run identity is absent.
DONE + RETURN proves lifecycle closure, not that STARTED was persisted before the first substantive action unless ordering has its own durable evidence.
Declared write_scope is a contract; independent isolation proof needs actual write-set/commit evidence.
Substantive candidate content is not equivalent to parent/steward acceptance or product authority.
write_scope_observed: claim + own run + own return only
